column1: Per patient, the 5 seed probabilities (within its single outer-fold test set) are averaged -> one probability per patient. The 705 patients are bootstrap-resampled (B=5000, paired across conditions) and metrics recomputed at a FIXED 0.5 threshold (no per-condition threshold optimisation). Δ = mean(condition - sampler) over resamples; boot_p = 2*min(P(Δ>0), P(Δ<0)). Computed by codes/patient_bootstrap.py.
